Natasha's dedication to quality has transformed the commonly tricky-to-use dry purple eyeshadow pigments into a new luxurious standard of fallout-free purple shades with full-colour payoff.

description: Expanding on Natasha’s innovative eye sculpting concept, first introduced in her mini eye sculpt eyeshadow palette, she elevates her vision with different textures and undertones in the New Eye Sculpt Texture and Tone Palettes— soft and dramatic. Debuting a brand-new midi + size, these 18-pan palettes are designed for ultimate versatility. Each vertical column presents a different undertone— yellow, cool, rosy, peach, warm and neutral—ranging from the fairest shades to the deepest black hues. Following the iconic hy-glam™ concealer undertone system, each shade is named according to its undertone. For example, yellow undertone shades begin with a “y” in their shade name, making it easier than ever to achieve sculpted, dimensional eye looks tailored to every skin tone.
additional_benefits: With a user-friendly layout, both palettes offer the freedom to mix and match undertones or follow guided shade combinations by row. Each vertical column presents a specific undertone, perfect for easy monochromatic looks, while horizontal progression from light to dark shades provides a seamless structure for eye sculpting. This set-up allows for endless styles, from classic everyday to bold, dramatic looks, tailored to various skin tones and preferences. Each palette pairs beautifully with others, enhancing and complementing a range of colours and finishes. The Matte formulas create an ideal base, perfect for layering with Metallics, Shimmers, or Sparkling Finishes to add depth and dimension to any look.

description:
Introducing the new Luxe Glam Compact, Natasha’s first‑ever quad eyeshadow palette. It brings back her nostalgic, large‑sized 2.5 g pans from the original 28‑pan palettes that made her brand known for blendable, high‑pigment, pro‑performance and user‑friendly eyeshadows.
This quad comes in three colour styles—Nude, Cool and Rosy—featuring Natasha’s fan‑favourite shades in her iconic sparkling foiled, metallic and matte formulas.
The new Luxe Glam Compact format includes a built‑in mirror, a metalised grid, a tinted plexiglass base and a sparkling glossy cover, elegantly finished with the signature debossed ND monogram.
additional_benefits: With large, user-friendly pans, this palette is perfect for any eyeshadow brush and finger application, maximising the true ND eyeshadow experience and delivering the maximum level of unmatched colour pay-off for quick and effortless complete ND looks. Combining modern luxury and pro-level artistry, the luxe glam compact includes everything you need for everyday to smokey and multi-textured dramatic eyes.

description: A mini palette of 5 warm-toned neutrals in creamy matte and metallic finishes for summer and fall.
additional_benefits: From a smoky bronze eye to a subtle wash of summer shimmer, this travel-sized palette easily takes your look from day to night and allows you to complete a whole look on-the-go. These shades wear beautifully on all skin tones.

description: A best-selling nude lipstick in a new, creamy gel-based lip formula, debuted in the I Need a Rose Lipstick collection, that delivers glistening, full-coverage colour with super-soft hydration and a lightweight, luminous modern finish.
additional_benefits:
This lightweight creamy formula with a softly luminous finish is deeply hydrating for comfortable and luxurious texture and all-day wear on the lips. Containing enzyme-rich papaya extracts for antioxidant benefits, this moisturising formula also includes emollient aloe vera for all-day
hydration and comfortable, flexible wear.

description: Introducing Natasha's beloved Macro Tech Eye Crayon in a beautiful, universal Taupe shade, first debuted as a mini in the I need a nude eye kit, is now available in full size. The creamy, easy-to-use, waterproof and sharpenable crayon is ideal for defining the lash line and adding dimension to the eyes with a subtle chic pop of colour - the perfect addition to all neutral, warm and cool-toned palettes to complete any eye look.
additional_benefits: The Macro Tech Eye Crayon delivers 24-hour smudge-free wear with rich, long-lasting pigment. The creamy formula allows for precise application and effortless blending with or on top of any eyeshadow formula. Rich, creamy texture that glides smoothly without losing pigmentation. Sharpenable tip for maximum control and precise lines, offering a smooth glide to define the lash line. Waterproof formula designed for all-day wear without transferring or smudging.

description: The midi-size My Dream Eyeshadow Palette brings together 15 of Natasha’s favourite eyeshadows in a captivating constellation of shades inspired by the elements of life that illuminate and intensify her creative vision.
additional_benefits: With burgundy, brown, and coral mattes offset by bursts of neutral golden shimmer and high shine metallics, My Dream Eyeshadow Palette is encased in packaging hand-designed by Natasha and featuring her own handwriting. Including 2 of Natasha’s favourite existing shades, My Dream Eyeshadow Palette also introduces 13 brand new shades, including a vibrant multichrome with a high-impact foiled finish, and two sparkling duochromes that can also be worn as toppers. Whether she’s wearing her signature smoky cat eye or elevated evening glam, these are the shades and formulas Natasha loves most, all woven into an ultra-wearable colour story that's perfect for everyone.

description: Natasha Denona’s highly anticipated midi-sized Xenon Eyeshadow Palette is the ultimate cool-toned everyday eyeshadow palette. This 15-shade extravaganza is the colour extension to the globally embraced Mini Xenon Palette and contains an array of vibrant pigments to produce her signature smokey eye looks. From classic to cat, soft to sultry, the vivid grays, sparkling silvers, icy pinks, and nude formulas complete any desired look with ease.
additional_benefits: Explore an extraordinary amount of versatility with this classically chic eyeshadow palette containing an array of textured shades inspired by Natasha’s passion for high-class and uncompromising quality. This ultra-wearable and playful palette achieves the ultimate glam, adding drama by achieving smokey eye styles and finishes.

description: An eyeshadow palette for the ultimate glam look while also perfect for creating every day looks.
additional_benefits: This palette features matte, metallic and sparkly cool-toned golden taupe and neutral shades.

description: Desiring to craft a compact essential that is easy-to-use and effortless to create quick 2-step eyeshadow looks, Natasha introduces a Brand-New constellation - the Essential Eyeshadow Duo. This Matte and Sparkling Compact includes 2 large 2.5g pans – the same size from her iconic 28-pan palettes. It showcases her popular Sparkling Wet Effect shade ‘Mia’ from the I Need a Nude Palette, perfectly paired with complementing Matte shade 'Transition' from the Glam Eyeshadow Palette. Encased in metallic sparkling packaging and completed with a built-in mirror, this duo creates complete eye looks for on-the-go.
additional_benefits: Featuring a wearable icy pink shade and a versatile light medium nude, the Essential Eyeshadow Duo creates everything from everyday monochromatic eyes with a single swipe of eyeshadow to soft holiday looks using both shades.

description: Introducing a Brand New concept, Natasha Denona reveals the Hy-per Natural Face Palette, an innovative, Hy-Brid no-makeup-makeup version of her iconic eyeshadows and bestselling face palettes. Featuring 5 eyeshadows, named after moods and occasions, to be used individually for a natural mono look or paired together for added dimension. Debuting a New talc-free, vegan Hy-per Silk formula, a silky soft gel-powder texture that comes in 4 wearable shades, and 1 sparkling topper in Natasha’s newest Sparkling Wet Effect finish, alongside a creamy powder Blush Duo and a versatile Hy-tech Bronzer & Contour Trio, sealing the perfect no-makeup-makeup routine in an everyday, travel-friendly essential.
additional_benefits: All formulas in this perfect on-the-go palette are mistake-proof, support the skin's ability to maintain its natural hydration, and allow for quick and easy finger or brush application. The multifunctional universal Bronzer & Contour trio can sculpt or highlight the face, delivering a natural matte finish. The Blush Duo's highly-pigmented baby pink and coral shades deliver a smooth, airbrushed finish and a naturally healthy, flushed-looking cheek. This eye and cheek essential effortlessly elevates everyday no-makeup-makeup looks to casual evening glam.

description: A long-lasting creaseless concealer with a natural, medium buildable-coverage luminous matte finish, made with bio-mimetic pigments & texture-perfecting microspheres for flawless, air-brushed results with a weightless natural look and a supremely flexible feel.
additional_benefits: Featuring a modern, ultra-fluid consistency that evenly suspends a high concentration of pigment, HY-Glam Correcting Concealer can be blended and sheered without breaking, flaking, or patchiness.  Because “very little goes a very long way”, you can effortlessly achieve a flawless matte finish with just a drop, an innovative approach meaning you have instant one-stroke perfection that can be blended out to your exact desired level of coverage. Adjusting to any irregularities in the skin’s surface, the crease-proof formula uses a unique butterflow technology and flexible resins for a high-comfort texture that moves with your skin to lock in coverage for all-day wear. Powered by a trio of botanical stem-cell actives, HY-Glam Correcting Concealer also helps to improve the appearance of fine lines over time and other signs of fatigue.

clean_product_name: I Need A Rouge Lip Syletto
description: A long-wearing, high-precision lip stylo in two must-have modern red shades that delivers one stroke colour in a lightweight layer of ravishing red that won't bleed, or feather.
additional_benefits: Natasha's take on the essential red lipstick comes in a new formula featuring emollient waxes and bio mimetic pigments for lasting hydration and a subtle luminous finish that fuses with lips for all day comfortable wear. Formulated with algae extract and milk thistle seed oil actives, I Need A Rouge Lip Styletto is rich in omega 3 fatty acids to nourish and replenish the skin's moisture barrier. Each Stylo pairs perfectly with its matching shade of I Need A Rouge Lip Crayon. It is presented in elegant, super slim 0.6 mm packaging for razor sharp pro-level precision, allowing the creamy, hydrating formula to give full-coverage, vibrant red lips in one swipe

description: A face palette that includes both eye and cheek essentials in universal neutral tones.
additional_benefits: This palette is perfect for traveling and for creating everyday looks on- the-go. Designed with a luxurious, never- before-seen ND exclusive packaging, it comes in 2 different tones with lighter or darker shades to complement all skin tones. Provides maximum colour payoff with minimal effort, blending seamlessly to achieve vibrant, ultra-pigmented, looks. These rich pressed pigmented shadows and blushes leave the skin with an optimal texture and comfortable all- day wear. Shades and formulas were hand designed by world renowned makeup artist Natasha Denona. Made with the highest quality pure colour pigments, dazzling chroma crystals, and luminous mineral pearls. Its buttery smooth, hydrating eyeshadow formula wears beautifully on any skin type and skin tone.

description:
Extending the Hy-Gen collection, the innovative Hy-Gen Tinted Lip

Mask ensures essential daily lip care, nourishment and beautifully

Luscious-looking lips. This balmy alcohol-free formula gently tints the lips

And doubles as a pampering lip mask, boosting the lips’ natural

Hydration.

The perfectly balanced complex of powerful actives, botanical oils and

Emollients ensures comfortable wear, creating a delicate, wet-shine,

Luminous finish, leaving the lips plump, soft, and supple.
additional_benefits:
With vitis vitatm infused with hyaluronic acid, the hy-gen tinted lip mask promotes collagen production while delicately enveloping the lips in a luminous, sheer, non-oily veil, stimulating circulation for a naturally voluptuous pout.
Formulated with a new gel polymer, hydrating emollients & phytosqualane, this lip mask quenches the lips, protects from moisture loss, and restores the skin's barrier.

With the added benefit of vita rosetm, it actively reduces inflammatory responses for a soothing experience. The ergonomic applicator glides the formula across the lips with a buttery-smooth sensation, leaving them feeling hydrated and pampered.

description: A Hy-gen skincare-infused glow highlighting bouncy face powder that encapsules the luminosity of the best selling, innovative Hy-gen primer serum into a new multi-function powder version. Expanding the Hy-gen collection, this hybrid face illuminator is packed with beneficial ingredients that leave the skin with a silky-soft touch, and a natural and luminous finish.
additional_benefits: The Hy-gen skincare-infused glow beautifier adds a healthy, unmatched "Glow from within" look to the skin. Its unique gummy-like texture glides effortlessly onto the skin by application, offering seamless blending and incomparable smoothness. This groundbreaking formula containing 5 avocuta® t, and makes the complexion look and feel soft, hydrated and oil-balanced. With non-pigmented emollient pearls, the powder infuses the skin with a flawless luminosity. Available in 4 shades, this creamy-to-the-touch, lightweight and sheer bouncy powder feels weightless and provides a supernatural radiant finish.

description: Hy-Sculpt Liquid Bronzer is the new ultimate Hy-Brid serum-infused innovation for sculpting and bronzing. Over 3 years, Natasha developed this Hy-Brid liquid sculpting bronzer featuring Brand-New Grip-Tech Pigments™ – an all-new coating technology with an advanced flexible formula. This breakthrough technology ensures all-day creaseless wear, a blurring effect and a high-colour payoff with a natural matte finish. Housed in a luxe frosted glass pump, the weightless and pigmented, self-setting formula dispenses evenly for mistake-proof application. Designed to enhance, sculpt, bronze and warm facial features, it delivers a sun-kissed finish with a smooth, ultra-light feel. With a second-skin natural finish and its water resistant formula – it makes this the perfect summer essential. Available in 7 shades | Suitable for all skin types
additional_benefits: Utilizing Natasha's cutting-edge Grip-Tech Pigments™, the Hy-Sculpt Liquid Bronzer provides enhanced adhesion for long-wearing buildable coverage and a blurring second-skin finish. Infused with Sodium Hyaluronate, a superior derivative of Hyaluronic Acid, it penetrates deeper into the skin with lighter molecules to support both short and long-term hydration. This liquid bronzer effortlessly sculpts, defines and warms the complexion, making it the perfect tool to achieve a radiant, natural look or a more contoured, sculpted effect.

description: Expanding the classic, pink-neutral colour range of her Hy-Brid gel-to-powder cheek innovation, Hy-Blush, Natasha unveils 2 New shades, Lush Lila a playful, trendy cool-toned lilac cream blush and tinted highlighter duo and Nude Muse the ultimate neutral-bare-nude toned ensemble. These long-wearing Cloudy Cream Cheek Duos feature the same satisfying Hy-Brid texture that transforms from gel to powder upon application, delivering a seamless fusion of balmy semi-matte and soft glow finishes in this clean, vegan formula. Now available in 8 shades, Hy-Blush offers a neutral, buildable flush of colour designed to flatter every skin tone.
additional_benefits: Enriched with Vegan Squalane and Sunflower Wax, Natasha’s Hy-Blush maintains the skin's natural moisture balance, leaving a fresh, hydrated and plump look and feel. The perfectly pigmented Cream Blush has an ultra-lightweight, groundbreaking texture that allows for mistake-proof, airbrushed application and a vibrant flush of colour. The tinted highlighter adds a sheer glow with a soft hue, complementing the colour of the Cream Blush. With a lightweight texture that feels airy and weightless, it layers and blends flawlessly for a second-skin effect. This versatile formula can be applied directly on bare skin for a no-makeup-makeup look or layered on top of liquid or powder foundation for a full-glam look.

description: The My Mini Dream Eyeshadow Palette features Natasha’s favorite eyeshadow Nurture from the iconic midi-sized My Dream Palette complimented by 4 different tones and textures of that shade. Ranging from light to dark, this constellation of neutral taupe-nudes showcases Natasha’s signature Matte and Metallic formulas and is sealed in her own hand-painted designed palette.
additional_benefits: The My Mini Dream Palette’s neutral taupe color story is the ultimate essential for creating subtle everyday to dreamy glam looks. Perfect for on-the-go, this palette features Natasha’s ultra pigmented, seamlessly blendable formulas for all skill levels to achieve professional results.

description: An extension to the Mini Glam Palette featuring additional neutral and golden taupe shades with matte, metallic and sparkling finishes.
additional_benefits:
This ultimate everyday palette lets you create super dramatic smokey eyes as well as a variety of natural and extreme glam looks. For the first time presenting special insider makeup tips from Natasha Denona herself by naming the shade names after their ideal place to apply them, in order to recreate the whole ND glam makeup look. The shadows are formulated with crushed pearls and crystals, including varied distinctive textures for
seamless blending and maximum colour payoff to achieve vibrant, ultra-pigmented, long-lasting looks.

description: The Golden Highlighter Trio features a Brand-New hybrid formula that brings the luxurious feel of a cream to a wet powder form. Inspired by liquid gold metals, the cushiony and creamy texture transforms into a weightless layer of high-shine radiance upon application. The palette includes 3 mesmerising shades to suit all skin tones: Pearl - a soft golden champagne for fair to light skin tones, Glow - a nude gold for light to medium tan skin tones and Bronze - a golden bronze shade for tan to deep skin tones.
additional_benefits: The Golden Highlighter Trio’s unique formula is enriched with light-reflecting pearls that melt into the skin, creating a captivating metallic-effect finish. The highly pigmented formula effortlessly glides onto the skin with medium to high buildable coverage. Formulated with Sodium Hyaluronate on Bentonite, this innovative highlighter enhances the natural glow and deeply hydrates the skin, leaving it feeling silky-smooth and refreshed. The extremely-soft hybrid powder can be used on the cheeks, eyes, or collarbones for an all-over neutral golden glow. All shades in this universal palette can be used on all skin tones to illuminate the eyelids.

description: Bringing the best-selling creamy gel-based lip formula, debuted in the I Need A Rose Lipstick collection, in a new clean formula, the Berry Pop Lipstick delivers a glistening coverage with super-soft hydration and a lightweight, luminous modern finish, in a flattering cherry mauve shade.
additional_benefits: Providing a healthy cranberry sorbet lip look, this spring essential contains enzyme-rich papaya extracts for antioxidant benefits. The luxurious formula includes emollient aloe vera for all-day hydration and comfortable, flexible wear.

description: An ultimate palette featuring 5 essential shades to create Natasha Denona’s signature, smokey cat-eye.
additional_benefits: This eyeshadow palette includes creamy mattes and a highly-foiled metallic, perfect for bold and defined looks with a pop of dramatic glam. Not to mention, it’s the first and only mini palette to include the supremely rich and velvety blackest black eyeshadow. Shades and formulas are hand-designed by world-renowned makeup artist Natasha Denona, made with the highest quality pure colour pigments, dazzling chroma crystals, and luminous mineral pearls. Its buttery smooth, hydrating eyeshadow formula wears beautifully on any skin type and skin tone.

description: A light-diffusing powder blush that flatters every skin tone giving ultimate radiance.
additional_benefits: This blush is formulated with a special combination of Hyaluronic Acid and a selected Tropical Oil which makes Hyaluronic Acid even more efficient as it helps its penetration through the skin barrier.

description: Step into a new era of eye sculpting, where Natasha's renowned formulas merge with groundbreaking innovation. The Mini Eye Sculpt Eyeshadow Palette is a must-have companion for sculpting the eyes with a selection of natural, skin tone-inspired hues. Meticulously designed, this palette features a progression of eyeshadow shades from light to deep, crafted in Natasha's signature creamy matte and breakthrough silky matte formulas.
additional_benefits: This palette is the ultimate tool for effortlessly creating natural looks with added depth and dimension. The new innovative, talc-free silky matte formula seamlessly glides onto the lids, delivering a highly pigmented, velvety matte finish. Inspired by the allure of sculpting face powders, these eyeshadows are the ideal base for other formulas and toppers, perfect for layering and emphasizing the eyes to achieve effortless no-makeup-makeup looks to the most dramatic smokey eyes.

clean_product_name: I Need A Nude Lip Crayon Lip Liner Pencil
description: Introducing brand new modern shades to Natasha’s iconic I Need A Nude Lip Crayon range. This long-lasting, highly pigmented, luxurious creamy matte lip formula now features shade Cherry Blossom, a natural nude pink and Cherry Cola, a dark burgundy brown, inspired by the viral Cherry Cola lip trend. These lip crayons allow you to effortlessly sculpt, shape and enhance your natural lips for the ultimate lightweight all-day, smudge and transfer-proof wear.
additional_benefits: Infused with a blend of nourishing silky ester oils, the I Need A Nude Lip Crayon features a rich, buttery hydrating texture that delivers comfortable, non-drying pure matte coverage. Its lightweight, flexible, waterproof formula stays on the lips with no smudging, fading or transferring. This sharpenable lip pencil packs the intensity of a lipstick in a convenient pencil, offering a smooth, effortless glide that enhances and defines the lips with ease. Designed to be perfectly paired with the I Need A Nude Lipstick and the New Hy-Gloss for the perfect ND lip combos.

description:
After 4 years of extensive development and countless submissions to achieve her perfect formula, Natasha unveils her HY-Glam™ Foundation — her biggest complexion launch yet. Building on the global success and innovative concept of the HY-Glam™ Concealer, Natasha developed this innovative HY-Brid formula, fusing cutting-edge technology with a high-performance serum formula. Using Japanese Amino Acid Coated Bio-Mimetic Pigments, powered by Korean technology and formulated by Natasha with top Italian chemists, this skincare HY-Brid innovation unites global expertise in one revolutionary formula.

Formulated with New Amino Acid Coated Bio-Mimetic Pigments — an enhanced innovation of the Bio-Mimetic Pigments from her viral HY-Glam™ Concealer — HY-Glam™ Foundation delivers a flexible, creaseless and blurring finish without separating or settling into fine lines. With the weightless feel of a serum and medium-buildable coverage, this self-setting formula provides a long-lasting airbrushed, luminous finish for a natural, smooth, second-skin look. that lasts for up to 18 hours of wear. Colour-matched to all 52 concealer shades, this foundation follows Natasha's signature colour-matching system with the highly inclusive range of 4 undertones (Neutral, Yellow, Peach, Rosy) in all overtones from fair to deep.
additional_benefits: Infused with active ingredients — Jasmine Mother Cells, White Tea Silver Needle and Grape Pomace — HY-Glam™ Foundation is clinically proven to defend, soothe and repair sensitive skin while delivering anti-aging benefits, boosting collagen production, supporting cell detoxification and providing both short- and long-term hydration. This advanced formula brightens and fights hyperpigmentation, minimises imperfections and skin texture such as scars and blurs for a flawless complexion. The self-setting, hypoallergenic and non-comedogenic formula offers breathable, long-lasting coverage that lasts for up to 18 hours of wear. A balanced mix of emollients enhances natural radiance with a lightweight, luminous finish without feeling sticky. This versatile HY-Brid formula is suitable for all skin types. Formulated with Bamboo Powder and Microalgae — it provides a radiant glow, hydration and a soft feel while balancing excess oils.

description: Introducing the latest addition to Natasha's HY-Glam collection - the HY-Glam Powder Foundation. As the second complexion product in the hybrid full-glam collection following the game-changing, 5 star-rated HY-Glam Concealer that went viral in summer 2023, this Talc-free powder foundation delivers a full performance flexible formula, that features beneficial ingredients to support the skin's natural elasticity and hydration.
additional_benefits: Delivering a seamless application, the HY-Glam Powder Foundation provides medium-buildable coverage for a perfected second-skin look. The luminous matte finish leaves the complexion looking healthy and nourished, while the high-tech silky-soft formula blurs the skin’s texture, creating a smooth and poreless appearance. Packed with natural antioxidants such as Resveratrol, Flavonoids, and Ellagic Acid, the HY-Glam Powder Foundation helps protect the skin against environmental stressors and pollutants, and keeps the skin looking fresh and revitalised. Made with bio-mimetic pigments, this flexible powder formula moves with the skin and adjusts to any irregularity without breaking or flaking, allowing for airbrushed-looking results. HY-Glam Powder Foundation contains Berry Flex Vita to help maintain the skin’s hyaluronic acid to support hydration, and Anthocyanins offering anti-inflammatory properties which promote a calmer, more even skin tone. Enclosed within the compact, the innovative bouncy textured sponge was designed by Natasha to ensure minimal product absorption, a flawless application, and a natural, skin-like finish. With a diverse range of 36 shades, the HY-Glam Powder Foundation offers an ideal match for every skin tone.

description: Introducing The Golden Glimmer Gloss Shimmering Lip-Plumper, an oil-gloss formula that illuminates the lips with golden sparkles, creating a luscious, plumped pout. It offers a multidimensional sheer coverage with an iridescent sparkling finish. This modern formula coats the lips in a non-sticky, cushiony veil, delivering instant high-shine while providing ultra-comfortable wear.
additional_benefits: The Golden Glimmer Gloss creates the perfect plumped pout with a glossy, mirror-like shine that doesn't feel sticky or tacky. Enriched with key ingredients, including Maracuja Oil and emollient agents, this gloss soothes and refreshes dry, chapped lips to keep them hydrated and smooth all day. When applied, The Golden Glimmer Gloss leaves the lips with a slight tingling sensation and a noticeable plumped effect, maximised through ultra-reflective pearls.

description: With the overwhelming requests for Natasha to bring back one of her most loved palettes, she decided to create the Golden Eyeshadow Palette, a new and improved version of the original Gold Palette, with its core in mind. Unveiling brand-new and existing shades, the mesmerising 15-pan midi eyeshadow palette consists of cool-toned golden hues with sparkling nude champagne, lustrous ivory and vivid antique brass shades. This captivating colour story emulates the timeless allure of liquid gold.
additional_benefits: The Golden Palette combines versatile neutrals and rich statement metallics in Natasha's signature buttery-smooth, vibrant and ultra-pigmented formulas. The palette features 7 soft Mattes in 2 finishes - cream and pressed powder, 5 ultra-shiny Metallics, a glistening gold nude Sparkling Foiled Formula, a champagne Chroma Crystal topper with a diamond-like sparkle effect and a New Sparkling Wet Effect Formula in a golden nude. The palette's wearable cool-toned golden shades effortlessly complement all skin tones for an easy daytime glow or majestic evening glam.

description:
Following the success of her fan-favourite, first-ever Hy-Brid product, the original Hy-Gen Primer Serum, Natasha introduces the Hy-Gen Primer Serum Bronze. This Primer Serum delivers the same silky, sheer consistency and dewy, plumping finish, now reinvented in a new bronzing version that warms the complexion with a sun-kissed luminosity that seems to come from within.

Featuring micro light-reflecting pearls that seamlessly blend into the skin, this sophisticated formula delivers a non-patchy, evenly distributed application with a bronzy glow for light skin and a natural glow-from-within for dark skin tones.
additional_benefits:
Unlike any other primer or serum, the Hy-Gen Primer Serum Bronze balances sebum while infusing the skin with up to 72 hours of continuous moisture. Suitable for dry, oily, or combination skin, it hydrates on application and enhances the skin’s ability to retain essential moisture over time, breaking the cycle of overactive oil production that leads to stressed, congested skin.

Fun Fact: Even after washing the face, this formula continues to hydrate due to its lightweight molecules that penetrate deep into the skin.

When incorporated into your daily skincare routine, this dermatologically tested blend of moisturising factors—including Mediterranean microalgae and Anti-aging peptides —reduces fine lines, hyperpigmentation and signs of fatigue, leaving your skin nourished, radiant and revitalised all day long.

description: The hy-gen face brush is a hy-per soft, handcrafted, dual-ended face and highlighting brush featuring the latest innovation in vegan, shed-free fiber technology. Designed to pair seamlessly with the hy-gen skincare infused glow beautifier, this durable brush is crafted from the highest-quality materials to provide a luxurious feel. This versatile brush is perfect for foundation application, delivering one-stroke perfection and an airbrushed finish.
additional_benefits: The hy-gen face brush is an ultra-soft, versatile tool with dual functionality. On one side, the dense angled face brush, is perfect for achieving an all-over glow with ease. It effortlessly buffs products onto the skin, ensuring an even and airbrushed finish. On the other side, the highlighting brush is tailored for precise and targeted highlighter application. With its super-soft bristles, this brush offers a luxurious and seamless makeup application experience.

description: A classic, ultra-moisturising gloss and the first to be offered in the bestselling shade “Natasha” from the I Need a Nude collection.
additional_benefits: This lusciously soft and conditioning lip shine with nourishing balm-like benefits and a subtle rosy tint, is a high-shine gloss that adds a diamond-bright dimension to any look. Enriched with soothing avocado oil, the cushiony, gel-like consistency keeps lips soft, supple and smooth throughout the day.

description: Building on her HY-BRID collection, Natasha extends this concept for the lip category with the All New Hy Gloss a Tinted Gloss Balm that perfectly balances wear, care and colour. Formulated with skin-loving active ingredients, this cushiony, buttery, high-shine lip essential hydrates, smooths and repairs, all while providing true colour payoff and a glossy finish without feeling sticky. Launching in 7 most-loved shades, HY-GLOSS complements the new HY-BLUSH hues and both new and existing shades of the I Need a Nude Lip Crayons. It can be worn alone for no-makeup-makeup or paired with an ND lip crayon for a more defined look.
additional_benefits:
Infused with nourishing, age-defying actives, HY-GLOSS hydrates and smoothes lips for a refreshed, full-looking pout.

description: A lightweight primer serum with a silky consistency and a dewy, plumping finish.
additional_benefits: This ingenious formula, made with crystal-like ultra-fine reflecting pigments, awakens the skin and delivers a translucent luminosity that seems to come from within. When used as part of your daily skincare routine, the dermatologically tested blend of moisturizing factors, including Mediterranean Microalgae and Anti-Aging Peptides. Whether skin is dry, oily, or combination, Hy-Gen SkinGlass hydrates on application and improves the skin’s ability to maintain essential moisture over time, breaking the cycle of overactive oil production that leads to stressed, congested skin. A blend of Hyaluronic Acid, Natural Moisturizing Sugars, and Powerful Humectants with Double-Moisturizing Action immediately supply hydration that lasts up to 72 hours. description:
Black Opium Eau de Parfum is the iconic coffee-floral women’s fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent, that redefines femininity with bold sensuality. A warm and spicy blend where the intensity of black coffee notes meets the creamy sweetness of vanilla bourbon and the delicate allure of Arabian jasmine. Energising yet addictive, this perfume captures the electrifying spirit of the modern, fearless woman who embraces the night.

The Inspiration
Irresistible and daring, this fragrance embodies the audacious spirit of Yves Saint Laurent a charismatic, confident woman with an unstoppable energy.

A Sensual Contrast of Light and Darkness
Breaking boundaries in perfumery, Black Opium pioneers a powerful coffee note, an ingredient rarely used in such intensity in a women's fragrance. The electrifying black coffee accord ignites the senses, blending seamlessly with the soft, sensual essence of white floral fragrances like orange blossom perfume and jasmine, deepened by the rich warmth of patchouli perfume, cedarwood, and white musk perfume. A rush of sensuality that lingers all night long.

A Bottle Designed to Shine All Night
Inspired by the iconic OPIUM fragrance from 1977, Black Opium is a black diamond in the rough—a dazzling mix of black glitter and intense lacquer that reveals a fiery, glowing centre. Tactile and hypnotic, it fits effortlessly in your hand, becoming a part of you.
additional_benefits: As thrilling as that first shot of caffeine, Black Opium plays on the radical tension between the dark bitterness of coffee bean, the luminescence femininity of white flowers a daring contrast of light and dark, enriched by the sensual appeal of vanilla for long lasting pleasure. A precious juice encapsulated inside a shimmering black glitter bottle, as if dressed in sequins. A scent of desire, of always wanting more, never quite enough.
